verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת בְּנֵי־ נֹ֔חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֣ם וָיָ֑פֶת וַיִּוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם בָּנִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ bə·nê- nō·aḥ šêm ḥām wā·yā·p̄eṯ way·yiw·wā·lə·ḏū lā·hem bā·nîm ’a·ḥar ham·mab·būl
verses.literal: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem Ham and Japheth . . . who also had sons after the flood
verses.literalPt: Estas são as gerações de Sem, Cam e Jafé, filhos de Noé; e a estes nasceram filhos depois do dilúvio.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ye·p̄eṯ gō·mer ū·mā·ḡō·wḡ ū·mā·ḏay wə·yā·wān wə·ṯu·ḇāl ū·me·šeḵ wə·ṯî·rās
verses.literal: The sons of Japheth Gomer Magog Madai Javan Tubal Meshech and Tiras
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jafé são: Gômer, Magogue, Madai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque e Tiras.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְרִיפַ֖ת וְתֹגַרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê gō·mer ’aš·kă·naz wə·rî·p̄aṯ wə·ṯō·ḡar·māh
verses.literal: The sons of Gomer Ashkenaz Riphath and Togarmah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gômer: Asquenaz, Rifá e Togarma.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּתִּ֖ים וְדֹדָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yā·wān ’ĕ·lî·šāh wə·ṯar·šîš kit·tîm wə·ḏō·ḏā·nîm
verses.literal: And the sons of Javan Elishah Tarshish the Kittites and the Rodanites
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Javã: Elisá, Társis, Quitim e Dodanim.

verses.original: מֵ֠אֵלֶּה נִפְרְד֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ בְּאַרְצֹתָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לִלְשֹׁנ֑וֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’êl·leh nip̄·rə·ḏū ’î·yê hag·gō·w·yim bə·’ar·ṣō·ṯām ’îš lil·šō·nōw lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām bə·ḡō·w·yê·hem
verses.literal: From these the maritime peoples separated into their territories according to their languages by clans within their nations
verses.literalPt: Por estes foram repartidas as ilhas das nações nas suas terras, cada qual segundo a sua língua, segundo as suas famílias, entre as suas nações.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּפ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḥām kūš ū·miṣ·ra·yim ū·p̄ūṭ ū·ḵə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: The sons of Ham Cush Mizraim Put and Canaan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Cam: Cuxe, Mizraim, Pute e Canaã.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥ה וְרַעְמָ֖ה וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖ה שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḵūš sə·ḇā wa·ḥă·wî·lāh wə·saḇ·tāh wə·ra‘·māh wə·saḇ·tə·ḵā ū·ḇə·nê ra‘·māh šə·ḇā ū·ḏə·ḏān
verses.literal: The sons of Cush Seba Havilah Sabtah Raamah and Sabteca And the sons of Raamah Sheba and Dedan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Cuxe: Sebá, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá e Sabtecá; e os filhos de Raamá: Sabá e Dedã.

verses.original: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ נִמְרֹ֑ד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִֽהְי֥וֹת גִּבֹּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵūš yā·laḏ ’eṯ- nim·rōḏ hū hê·ḥêl lih·yō·wṯ gib·bōr bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Cush was the father of Nimrod who began to be a mighty one on the earth
verses.literalPt: Cuxe gerou a Ninrode, que começou a ser poderoso na terra.

verses.original: הֽוּא־ הָיָ֥ה גִבֹּֽר־ צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֙ יֵֽאָמַ֔ר כְּנִמְרֹ֛ד גִּבּ֥וֹר צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hū- hā·yāh ḡib·bōr- ṣa·yiḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- kên yê·’ā·mar kə·nim·rōḏ gib·bō·wr ṣa·yiḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD so . . . it is said Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ele era poderoso caçador diante de Jeová; pelo que se diz: Como Ninrode, poderoso caçador diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י רֵאשִׁ֤ית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶ֖רֶךְ וְאַכַּ֣ד וְכַלְנֵ֑ה בְּאֶ֖רֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî rê·šîṯ mam·laḵ·tōw bā·ḇel wə·’e·reḵ wə·’ak·kaḏ wə·ḵal·nêh bə·’e·reṣ šin·‘ār
verses.literal: His kingdom began in Babylon Erech Accad and Calneh in the land of Shinar
verses.literalPt: O princípio de seu reino foi Babel, Ereque, Acade e Calné, na terra de Sinear.

verses.original: מִן־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא יָצָ֣א אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ נִ֣ינְוֵ֔ה וְאֶת־ רְחֹבֹ֥ת עִ֖יר וְאֶת־ כָּֽלַח׃
verses.transliteration: min- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hi·w yā·ṣā ’aš·šūr way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- nî·nə·wêh wə·’eṯ- rə·ḥō·ḇōṯ ‘îr wə·’eṯ- kā·laḥ
verses.literal: From that land he went forth into Assyria where he built Nineveh Rehoboth-Ir . . . Calah
verses.literalPt: Daquela terra saiu ele para a Assíria e edificou Nínive, Reobote-Ir, Calá

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ רֶ֔סֶן בֵּ֥ין נִֽינְוֵ֖ה וּבֵ֣ין כָּ֑לַח הִ֖וא הָעִ֥יר הַגְּדֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- re·sen bên nî·nə·wêh ū·ḇên kā·laḥ hî hā·‘îr hag·gə·ḏō·lāh
verses.literal: and Resen which is between Nineveh . . . and the great city of Calah . . .
verses.literalPt: e Resém entre Nínive e Calá (esta é a grande cidade).

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־ לוּדִ֧ים וְאֶת־ עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־ לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־ נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ra·yim yā·laḏ ’eṯ- lū·ḏîm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·nā·mîm wə·’eṯ- lə·hā·ḇîm wə·’eṯ- nap̄·tu·ḥîm
verses.literal: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites the Anamites the Lehabites the Naphtuhites
verses.literalPt: Mizraim gerou a Ludim, Anamim, Leabim, Naftuim,

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־ כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- paṯ·ru·sîm wə·’eṯ- kas·lu·ḥîm ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū miš·šām pə·liš·tîm wə·’eṯ- kap̄·tō·rîm
verses.literal: the Pathrusites the Casluhites from whom the Philistines came and the Caphtorites
verses.literalPt: Patrusim, Casluim (donde saíram os filisteus) e Caftorim.

verses.original: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־ צִידֹ֥ן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־ חֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·na·‘an yā·laḏ ’eṯ- ṣî·ḏōn bə·ḵō·rōw wə·’eṯ- ḥêṯ
verses.literal: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn and of the Hittites
verses.literalPt: Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito, e a Hete,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hay·ḇū·sî wə·’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’êṯ hag·gir·gā·šî
verses.literal: the Jebusites the Amorites the Girgashites
verses.literalPt: e ao jebuseu, o amorreu, o girgaseu,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַֽחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַסִּינִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥiw·wî wə·’eṯ- ha·‘ar·qî wə·’eṯ- has·sî·nî
verses.literal: the Hivites the Arkites the Sinites
verses.literalPt: o heveu, o arqueu, o sineu,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָֽאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־ הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְאַחַ֣ר נָפֹ֔צוּ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·wā·ḏî wə·’eṯ- haṣ·ṣə·mā·rî wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·mā·ṯî wə·’a·ḥar nā·p̄ō·ṣū miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî
verses.literal: the Arvadites the Zemarites and the Hamathites Later the Canaanite clans were scattered
verses.literalPt: o arvadeu, o zemareu e o hamateu; e depois se espalharam as famílias dos cananeus.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִצִּידֹ֔ן בֹּאֲכָ֥ה גְרָ֖רָה עַד־ עַזָּ֑ה בֹּאֲכָ֞ה סְדֹ֧מָה וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאַדְמָ֥ה וּצְבֹיִ֖ם עַד־ לָֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇūl hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî miṣ·ṣî·ḏōn bō·’ă·ḵāh ḡə·rā·rāh ‘aḏ- ‘az·zāh bō·’ă·ḵāh sə·ḏō·māh wa·‘ă·mō·rāh wə·’aḏ·māh ū·ṣə·ḇō·yim ‘aḏ- lā·ša‘
verses.literal: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza and then toward Sodom Gomorrah Admah and Zeboiim as far as Lasha
verses.literalPt: Era o termo dos cananeus desde Sidom, no caminho de Gerar, até Gaza; e no caminho de Sodoma, Gomorra, Admá e Zeboim, até Lasa.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־ חָ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹֽׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- ḥām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lil·šō·nō·ṯām bə·’ar·ṣō·ṯām bə·ḡō·w·yê·hem
verses.literal: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans languages lands and nations
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Cam segundo a sua família, segundo as suas línguas, nas suas terras, nas suas nações.

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֥ם יֻלַּ֖ד גַּם־ ה֑וּא אֲבִי֙ כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ עֵ֔בֶר אֲחִ֖י יֶ֥פֶת הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šêm yul·laḏ gam- hū ’ă·ḇî kāl- bə·nê- ‘ê·ḇer ’ă·ḥî ye·p̄eṯ hag·gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: And sons were also born . . . to Shem the older brother of Japheth Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber
verses.literalPt: A Sem, que foi pai de todos os filhos de Éber e irmão mais velho de Jafé, a ele também nasceram filhos.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י שֵׁ֖ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֑וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֥וּד וַֽאֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šêm ‘ê·lām wə·’aš·šūr wə·’ar·paḵ·šaḏ wə·lūḏ wa·’ă·rām
verses.literal: The sons of Shem Elam Asshur Arphaxad Lud and Aram
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Sem: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude e Arã.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י אֲרָ֑ם ע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמַֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ’ă·rām ‘ūṣ wə·ḥūl wə·ḡe·ṯer wā·maš
verses.literal: The sons of Aram Uz Hul Gether and Mash
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Arã: Uz, Hul, Géter e Más.

verses.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־ עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·paḵ·šaḏ yā·laḏ ’eṯ- šā·laḥ wə·še·laḥ yā·laḏ ’eṯ- ‘ê·ḇer
verses.literal: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah and Shelah was the father of Eber
verses.literalPt: Arfaxade gerou a Salá, e Salá gerou a Éber.

verses.original: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָֽאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יָקְטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·‘ê·ḇer yul·laḏ šə·nê ḇā·nîm šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ pe·leḡ kî ḇə·yā·māw nip̄·lə·ḡāh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šêm ’ā·ḥîw yā·qə·ṭān
verses.literal: Two sons were born to Eber One was named Peleg because in his days the earth was divided and his brother was named Joktan
verses.literalPt: A Éber nasceram dois filhos: o nome de um foi Pelegue, porque nos seus dias foi dividida a terra; e o nome de seu irmão foi Joctã.

verses.original: וְיָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־ שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־ חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ יָֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·qə·ṭān yā·laḏ ’eṯ- ’al·mō·w·ḏāḏ wə·’eṯ- šā·lep̄ wə·’eṯ- ḥă·ṣar·mā·weṯ wə·’eṯ- yā·raḥ
verses.literal: And Joktan was the father of Almodad Sheleph Hazarmaveth Jerah
verses.literalPt: Joctã gerou a Almodá, Salefe, Hazar-Mavé, Jerá,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־ אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־ דִּקְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hă·ḏō·w·rām wə·’eṯ- ’ū·zāl wə·’eṯ- diq·lāh
verses.literal: Hadoram Uzal Diklah
verses.literalPt: Hadorão, Uzal, Dicla,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עוֹבָ֥ל וְאֶת־ אֲבִֽימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־ שְׁבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·w·ḇāl wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·mā·’êl wə·’eṯ- šə·ḇā
verses.literal: Obal Abimael Sheba
verses.literalPt: Obal, Abimael, Sabá,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אוֹפִ֥ר וְאֶת־ חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־ יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ō·w·p̄ir wə·’eṯ- ḥă·wî·lāh wə·’eṯ- yō·w·ḇāḇ kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê yā·qə·ṭān
verses.literal: Ophir Havilah and Jobab All these were sons of Joktan
verses.literalPt: Ofir, Havilá e Jobabe; todos estes foram filhos de Joctã.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֥י מוֹשָׁבָ֖ם מִמֵּשָׁ֑א בֹּאֲכָ֥ה סְפָ֖רָה הַ֥ר הַקֶּֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mō·wō·šā·ḇām mim·mê·šā bō·’ă·ḵāh sə·p̄ā·rāh har haq·qe·ḏem
verses.literal: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar in the eastern hill country
verses.literalPt: Foi a sua habitação desde Messa, no caminho de Sefar, monte do Oriente.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־ שֵׁ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם לְגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- šêm lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lil·šō·nō·ṯām bə·’ar·ṣō·ṯām lə·ḡō·w·yê·hem
verses.literal: These are the sons of Shem according to their clans languages lands and nations
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Sem segundo as suas famílias, segundo as suas línguas, nas suas terras, segundo as suas nações.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֧ת בְּנֵי־ נֹ֛חַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶ֑ם וּמֵאֵ֜לֶּה נִפְרְד֧וּ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh miš·pə·ḥōṯ bə·nê- nō·aḥ lə·ṯō·wl·ḏō·ṯām bə·ḡō·w·yê·hem ū·mê·’êl·leh nip̄·rə·ḏū hag·gō·w·yim bā·’ā·reṣ ’a·ḥar ham·mab·būl
verses.literal: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons according to their generations and nations From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood
verses.literalPt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Noé segundo as suas gerações, nas suas nações; e destes foram disseminadas as nações na terra depois do dilúvio.
